description: Register once and receive a one-time API key. Store it in connector secret settings as Authorization: Bearer <key>; never repeat it in conversation, URLs, or tool arguments. The tool response contains the key once. If your client retains tool history or cannot securely store headers, use out-of-chat registration and the OAuth follow-up. Test an existing stored key with agent_whoami before registering again.

displayName.description: Optional public display name; your private name and email are not public card fields.
